xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4257: Tier effort reaches slots: per-slot effort from the tier table, and escalation raises effort before promoting the model

plan.title: Tier effort reaches slots: per-slot effort from the tier table, and escalation raises effort before promoting the model
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Tier effort (tiered_execution.tiers.<t>.effort, added by PAN-4249) never reaches a launch. spawnRun forwards one caller effort to every swarm slot (spawn.ts:173-174) and spawnAgent stages the caller effort that pan start computed without a tier (spawn.ts:705, :810). Staffing has no effort field. The tier supervisor and merge-train re-review record no effort. Escalation has no effort concept, and its decision engine was deleted (PAN-4014) after the Cut removed its triggers. Settings drops tier effort on save because crews dedupe on model+harness, and sub-role cards cannot set effort.
narratives.Proposal: resolveStaffing returns effort and effortSource from resolveEffort (item > plan > tier > roles.work > project > default; no tier for implicit staffing). Tier spawn params carry it. A new leaf launch-effort.ts picks the launch effort: an explicit caller effort wins, else the staffed effort, else the caller value; spawn.ts applies it in the slot branch and in spawnAgent. The tier supervisor and merge-train re-review resolve at the callsite. escalation.effort_first is validated (omitted when unset). A pure decideEscalation is restored with one new step before promotion (raise effort one supported level, once per difficulty), plus a pure applyEscalationAction; applyEffectiveDifficulty overlays the raised effort so staffing sees it at the item layer. Settings gains a per-crew effort select (crews key on effort), an effort-first switch that edits preserve, and a per-sub-role effort select. configuration/effort.mdx documents all of it and says no automatic escalation trigger fires yet (PAN-4512).
narratives.NonGoals:
- No live escalation trigger and no continue-file writer for tierOverrides (PAN-4512).
- No new EffortSource value; an escalated effort resolves as source 'item'.
- No general effort default for role runs in spawnRun (review parent, test, worker, sequencer, knowledge, plan) — PAN-4256.
- No edits to src/lib/cloister/deacon-swarm.ts (at its file-size cap, needs no change) or src/lib/cloister/swarm-foreman.ts (covered through spawnAgent).
- No change to the lint:effort baseline or the local `type Effort` copy in RolesPanel.tsx (PAN-4256 owns that row).
- No effort display in Agents rows, issue view or pan status (PAN-4259).
- No file-size allowlist row added or raised.
- No xhigh or max default anywhere.

autoDecisions.summary: Escalation has no live trigger since the Cut; restore a pure decideEscalation + applyEscalationAction and prove the path through resolveStaffing in tests, filing PAN-4512 for the trigger.
autoDecisions.rationale: docs/THE-CUT.md:131-132 records the triggers as deliberately dropped and PAN-4014 deleted the dead engine. Re-wiring a trigger is a separate design decision outside this slice; the issue's acceptance criterion is a test of the escalation sequence.

autoDecisions.summary: A caller effort overrides staffing only when its source is 'explicit' (or absent); otherwise the staffed, tier-aware effort wins.
autoDecisions.rationale: pan start always passes a tier-less resolved effort with a source; staffing's chain is a superset of that chain, so replacing non-explicit values loses nothing while pan start --effort still wins.

autoDecisions.summary: Implicit staffing passes no tierName to resolveEffort.
autoDecisions.rationale: Its tierName 'default' is a label, not a configured tier; a configured tier named 'default' must not leak into non-tiered issues.

autoDecisions.summary: The raised effort is overlaid as item metadata.effort, so staffing reports source 'item'; no new EffortSource value.
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches how promotions already overlay metadata.difficulty, and avoids changing a contracts union that PAN-4253/4255 persist and display.

autoDecisions.summary: Effort-first inserts one step between retry and promote, once per difficulty, to the next level the model supports; it does not count toward max_promotions, and promotion clears it.
autoDecisions.rationale: Literal reading of 'raise effort one level before promoting the model'; keeps PAN-3858's block/retry order intact so existing semantics are unchanged with effort_first off.

autoDecisions.summary: ValidatedEscalationConfig.effort_first is present only when the raw config sets it.
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps existing toEqual assertions on the escalation shape (settings-api, tier-table, swarm-tiered-hooks tests) green without editing them.

autoDecisions.summary: Tier supervisor and merge-train re-review resolve effort at their callsites instead of a general spawnRun role-run default.
autoDecisions.rationale: The general role-run default is PAN-4256's scope (review parent, test, worker); callsite resolution covers this issue's named sites and composes with PAN-4256.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep the Settings UI in this issue rather than splitting it into a sibling.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue scopes it explicitly, the projected surface is 25 files (at the finalize cap, not over), and splitting would leave a window where a Settings save drops tier effort and effort_first.
